race.comment: RUE DE ROYALE (5) travelled on the speed but felt the pinch in the closing stages over 1200m at Geelong last start. Third-up today which usually sees him hit form. Nicely placed over the extra 100m - just needs an ounce of luck from the tricky gate to be right in contention. CELSIUS STAR (3) opened this campaign with two fine efforts in strong provincial sprints before finding the Group 3 Rising Fast on Derby Day at Flemington a bridge too far. Back in his right race today and looks a major threat. MISS MAHJONG (11) made late ground but was no match for the winner over 1200m at Horsham recently. Up in class but gets some nice weight relief and she is a real tryer. PRINCESS QUE (8) showed a glimpse of form last time out when beaten under a length over 1200m at Seymour. Must be considered with the help of the inside gate. BLACK STORM (4) ran a cheeky race over 1400m at Bendigo last time. Should be in the firing line for a long way.
